release_channels.ask: How does the app reach people: app stores, a desktop installer, enterprise distribution? Are there beta channels?

supported_versions.ask: How long must older versions keep working once a new one ships?
supported_versions.why: Installed apps stay on people's devices, so the server has to keep talking to old versions.

rollout_plan.ask: How are releases rolled out and, if something goes wrong, rolled back?

user_created_data.ask: What do users create or change in the app, and what happens to it when they leave?
user_created_data.why: Data people create is the heart of an application's state model.

offline_use.ask: Must the app work without an internet connection? If so, what happens when changes made offline conflict?
offline_use.why: Offline support changes how data is stored, synced and recovered. If the answer is no, the offline parts of the design can be skipped.
offline_use.explain: Syncing is copying changes between the device and the server once a connection returns.

empty_error_states.ask: What should users see on first use, when there's nothing to show yet, and when an action fails?

docs/application/RELEASES.md.purpose: How installed client versions are released, supported, rolled out and rolled back.
docs/application/RELEASES.md.skip: Created only when the app ships as an installed client.
